---
name: PRISM Inventory File Location
description: Where to find the always-current PRISM inventory showing engines, dispatchers, actions, tests counts
type: reference
originSessionId: be182624-3e78-4961-85dd-4a444ed02fe4
---
The PRISM inventory file is at: `H:\prism\PRISM-INVENTORY-LATEST.md`

**Why:** This file is auto-generated by `scripts/update-prism-inventory.mjs` and always contains the current counts of engines, dispatchers, actions, tests, and other PRISM assets. It's overwritten each run so LATEST always has the freshest data.

**How to apply:** When asked about "PRISM inventory", "how many engines", "what's been built", or similar questions, read this file for accurate counts. Dated versions are also kept (e.g., PRISM-INVENTORY-2026-04-17.md).
